name: verifying-against-mockup
title_zh: 对照设计稿查代码，控件连错线也揪出来
tagline_zh: 不只是查元素在不在，还查「Abteilung」按钮真连到部门表而非分组表。六段审查链走完。
tagline_en: Not just existence—checks a control labelled 'Abteilung' truly maps to departments, not groups. Six-stage review.
desc_en: Use to check whether built code actually matches docs/design/manifest.yaml — not just that elements exist, but that a control labelled "Abteilung" is really wired to departments and not to groups. Runs a 6-stage review chain (structure/semantic/states/tokens/flow, then consolidation), applies provably correct fixes with a snapshot+diff, and gives a MATCH/MISMATCH verdict. Invoked by /design-verify
why_zh: 别的检查器只数 DOM 节点，它审语义、状态、令牌、流程。
why_en: Others count DOM nodes; this audits semantics, states, tokens, flow, then consolidates into executable fixes—each with snapshot.
limit_zh: 只认 docs/design/manifest.yaml 为唯一真源；产物须为可渲染的代码（HTML/组件）。
limit_en: Only docs/design/manifest.yaml is ground truth; needs renderable code (HTML/components). Pure backend or free-form visuals unsupported. Fixes only.
title_en: Verify code against mockup, catches miswired controls
